question: Ashgabat has a record-breaking Ferris wheel. What record does it hold?
answer: Ashgabat's Ferris wheel is the tallest covered one in the world, at 47.6 m. The whole wheel sits inside a building beneath a glass dome, so it never turns in the open air. The page lets you hold the button to ride the dark cabin to the top.
move: Ashgabat's record wheel is the tallest one built fully indoors: 47.6 m.
